description: React component for an editable page with drag-and-drop blocks, handling server updates, block addition/deletion, and cursor focus management.

methods.name: EditablePage
methods.description: React functional component managing editable page blocks with server synchronization and drag-and-drop.

methods.name: updatePageOnServer
methods.description: Updates the page data on the server via a PUT request when blocks change.

methods.name: deleteImageOnServer
methods.description: Deletes an image from the server given its URL.

methods.name: updateBlockHandler
methods.description: Updates a specific block in the state and deletes old image if changed.

methods.name: addBlockHandler
methods.description: Adds a new block after the current block.

methods.name: deleteBlockHandler
methods.description: Deletes a block and removes its image if applicable.

methods.name: onDragEndHandler
methods.description: Handles reordering of blocks after drag-and-drop.
